G.1.label: Partially disclosed
G.1.rationale: Risk Management Committee of the Board reviews climate-vulnerable district exposure in the Risk Appetite Statement quarterly; ICAAP climate review at board level; CSR & Sustainability Committee met twice. Narrow: no board oversight of climate strategy or targets described. Detail is in the bank's separate TCFD report.

G.2.label: Partially disclosed
G.2.rationale: ERM function coordinates climate risk; CSR & Sustainability Management Committee (CEO, COO, CFO, business heads) exists, but climate-specific management responsibilities, reporting lines and frequency are not described.

S.1.label: Partially disclosed
S.1.rationale: Physical risks identified (drought, cyclone, flood) for vulnerable districts; short/medium/long horizons mentioned but not defined; transition risks and opportunities (EV financing, green housing) only briefly mentioned.

S.2.label: Partially disclosed
S.2.rationale: Some business impacts: climate-informed branch expansion checklist, Green Finance Program / Green Deposit Policy. No discussion of impact on financial planning or financial performance.

S.3.label: Not disclosed
S.3.rationale: No scenario analysis reported; only 'evaluation of the feasibility of introducing climate stress testing' as a future focus area and NGFS scenarios as a training topic.

R.1.label: Partially disclosed
R.1.rationale: Identification of physical risk via CEEW district vulnerability assessment (8 -> 18 districts, High/Very High classes, combination-of-events); operational climate risk assessment initiated. Transition risk identification and significance determination not described.

R.2.label: Disclosed
R.2.rationale: Specific controls: exposure limit of 5% of outstanding portfolio for vulnerable districts reviewed quarterly (no breaches); five climate-related KRIs; branch-siting due diligence; BCP/DR considerations.

R.3.label: Disclosed
R.3.rationale: Climate risk explicitly within the Risk Appetite Statement, ERM function, Credit Monitoring Framework and ICAAP; operational risk and control framework being extended to climate.

M.1.label: Partially disclosed
M.1.rationale: Some climate metrics: share of portfolio in vulnerable districts vs 5% limit, energy use, emission intensity, renewable energy. No remuneration link, internal carbon price or opportunity metrics.

M.2.label: Disclosed
M.2.rationale: Scope 1 (601.8), Scope 2 (12,240.6) and Scope 3 (62,520.6 tCO2e incl. financed emissions for vehicle and housing loans) for three years, per GHG Protocol and PCAF, with intensities.

M.3.label: Partially disclosed
M.3.rationale: Only operational targets: Sanchaya programme 5% year-on-year energy reduction; portfolio exposure limit 5%. No GHG emissions reduction target, base year or long-term target.
